evals.prompt: Queremos reemplazar en AGS la rutina asignada por fecha: la coach publica rutinas para un rango, la alumna inicia como máximo una al día con Play, y una rutina incompleta se cierra al final del día conservando su porcentaje. Analiza el diseño antes de implementar y dime qué partes del skill y del status consultarías, los riesgos de migración y las pruebas necesarias.
evals.expected_output: A scoped architecture response that distinguishes current deployed date-bound assignments from the flexible target workflow, consults canonical product/data/status/workflow references, preserves historical assignments through migration, enforces one start per day and end-of-day closure, and proposes focused validation without claiming unverified implementation.
expectations: Identifies the existing date-bound CU-03 model as migration input rather than a parallel target workflow.
Uses the canonical product, data-contract, status, and workflow references instead of inventing a conflicting contract.
Includes tenant/student ownership and migration preservation of assignment prescriptions and snapshots.
Covers one routine start per day, same-day resume, end-of-day close with frozen progress, and next-day start eligibility.
Proposes focused tests and does not claim code, database, or Production changes were performed.

evals.prompt: Voy a persistir los checks por ejercicio para la nueva ejecución de rutina en Supabase. Diseña el cambio de dominio/repositorio/RLS y los tests, teniendo en cuenta que el porcentaje se calcula desde checks, que la alumna no puede iniciar dos rutinas el mismo día y que CU-04 (reps/peso/RIR/RPE) se implementará después.
evals.expected_output: A bounded implementation design separating cycle routine prescriptions, execution checks, and later CU-04 performance; it validates ownership, atomic daily-start enforcement, derived progress, day-end closure, and migration/cutover compatibility.
expectations: Treats progress percentage as derived from distinct exercise checks rather than independently mutable data.
Enforces the daily start limit transactionally or with an equivalent concurrency-safe server-side invariant.
Separates CU-03 completion checks from CU-04 actual sets, RIR, and RPE.
Includes RLS tests for student-own writes, coach-scoped reads, cross-tenant denial, and closed-execution immutability.
Includes regression/migration checks for existing assignment snapshots and does not create a parallel date-bound workflow.

evals.prompt: Necesito ajustar una pantalla de alumna de AGS en React. Hay que mantener el tema de la sede, accesibilidad móvil y los estados vacíos/error, y la pantalla debe mostrar el calendario, lo completado hoy y las rutinas disponibles. ¿Qué contexto revisarías antes de editar y cómo validarías el cambio?
evals.expected_output: A focused frontend workflow that consults the visual-system, product-context, project-status, and quality references, respects the current design system and flexible routine rules, and proposes concrete responsive/accessibility/state validation.
expectations: Consults the visual-system and product-context references before proposing UI changes.
Preserves tenant theme tokens and does not invent a separate visual system.
Uses the calendar as execution-date context rather than a routine-to-date assignment.
Includes mobile, accessibility, empty, loading, error, and permission-state checks.
Uses project-status to distinguish shipped behavior from planned behavior.
